name: YONGTAI
recent: Yong Tai 的私募计划在延长截止日 2026 年 11 月 5 日到期后结束，公司决定不再配售剩余股份。公司同时有多批 ICPS 转换为普通股并上市。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比大幅下滑，净亏损扩大。
notable: 私募计划在延长截止日 2026 年 11 月 5 日到期后结束，公司决定不再配售剩余股份。
公司完成多批 ICPS 2016/2026 转换为普通股，涉及 2,000 股和 29,800 股，分别于 2026 年 12 月 2 日和 9 月 4 日上市。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼（2026 年 9 月 9 日公告）。
最新季度营收同比下滑 77.2%，净亏损 678 万令吉，亏损较上季扩大。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 188.7 万令吉，环比下降 78.3%，同比下降 77.2%；净亏损 677.9 万令吉，净亏损率 359.2%，较上季的 23.5% 扩大。

recent_en: Yong Tai's private placement lapsed after the extended deadline of 5 November 2026, and the company decided not to place out the remaining shares. Several batches of ICPS were converted into ordinary shares and listed. Revenue fell sharply year-on-year in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, with net loss widening.
notable_en: The private placement lapsed after the extended deadline of 5 November 2026, and the company decided not to place out the remaining shares.
The company completed several conversions of ICPS 2016/2026 into ordinary shares, involving 2,000 shares and 29,800 shares, listed on 2 December 2026 and 4 September 2026 respectively.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation (announced on 9 September 2026).
Latest quarterly revenue fell 77.2% year-on-year, with a net loss of MYR 6.78 million, widening from the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1.887 million, down 78.3% QoQ and 77.2% YoY; net loss was MYR 6.779 million, with a net loss margin of 359.2%, widening from 23.5% in the previous quarter.
